thread:
samir: Hey folks, just started today. On MacBook Pro (Ventura) using company WireGuard with split-tunnel enabled. Trying to `docker pull registry.internal.redwood:5000/my-service:latest` and it hangs during TLS handshake. Public registries work fine. Anyone seen MacOS -> WG split tunnel weirdness?

infra-jen: welcome aboard! yep, MacOS has a quirk where the `utun` route sometimes takes precedence over the WG adapter for localhost-subnets we use for the internal registry. Can you paste `netstat -rn` and `scutil --proxy`? Also try `dig @10.10.0.2 registry.internal.redwood` to confirm DNS.

samir: netstat output (partial):
```
Routing tables
Internet:
Destination        Gateway            Flags   Refs     Use    Netif Expire
default            192.168.1.1        UGSc     10        0     en0
10/8               10.10.0.2          UCS      0        0     utun1
192.168.1/24       link#4             UCS      2        0     en0
```
scutil shows no HTTP proxy. dig against internal DNS returns 10.10.12.8 quickly. But curl to that IP times out.

ryan: probable missing route from the host to the internal gateway for the 10.10.0.0/16 via the WireGuard gateway. On mac you can `sudo route -n add -net 10.10.0.0/16 10.10.0.1` (replace gw with your WG peer IP). Also check the WireGuard macOS app settings: toggling "Route all traffic through VPN" off then back on sometimes repopulates routes correctly.

samir: tried adding the route to 10.10.0.1 but it says "SIOCADDRT: Network is unreachable". utun1 shows as the interface for 10/8 in the table so not sure why gw unreachable.

claire: If route add fails, another workaround is to run Docker inside a Linux VM (multipass or colima) that uses the host network; colima tends to pick up host routes better. For quick unblocking, I usually `ssh -J claire@bastion.internal registry-host` or use `docker --config /home/me/.docker/proxy` with an HTTP proxy through bastion. Not ideal but gets you moving.

infra-jen: created ticket INF-789: "macos utun route precedence - new hires". Assigning to eng-infra to look at WireGuard profiles for onboarding images. In the short term, two steps to try: 1) Disable split-tunnel temporarily in the Tunnel app and test; 2) try `sudo ifconfig utun1 down && sudo ifconfig utun1 up` to force reapply routes. Be careful with corporate device enrollment if you do that.

ops-bot: INF-789 updated: label onboarding, priority P2, assignee eng-infra.

samir: toggled the app off and back on, docker pull finally started. Will note both the Colima fallback and the route toggle in the onboarding checklist. Thanks all! :slightly_smiling_face:

ryan: welcome! ping me if you want help setting up colima/docker so you don't have to use bastion proxy.

samir: will do. Also went to the handbook and added a short note under "Network quirks" so future new hires won't lose time.
